description:
Shows the live status in the mobile header. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Open the diffs" means: wait (up to 30s) for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible, click the "Diffs" button in ".chat-workspace-actions" (if it is not visible, as on a phone, click the button "More options" instead and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"), and wait for the commit message. "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". "Remember where the content starts" means an eval with no expectation that sets window.__contentTop = document.querySelector(".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-content").getBoundingClientRect().y; "the content has not moved" means eval document.querySelector(".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-content").getBoundingClientRect().y === window.__contentTop is true. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/review and open the diffs (this phone hides the toolbar's buttons: click button[aria-label="More options"], then ".chat-overflow-popover button[aria-label^='Diffs']"). Remember where the content starts.
2. Click the start button. where's text should be exactly "commit message {{SHORT}} (new 1)".
3. The status should be visible inside ".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-header", and the content has not moved.
4. The pickers are covered rather than squeezed, and cannot be reached: ".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-mobile-selectors" should have the inert attribute with value exactly "" (eval getAttribute("inert") === "", expect true).
